entities.summary: Brendan Benson is an American musician and singer-songwriter. He plays guitar, bass guitar, keyboard, and drums. He has released eight solo albums and is a member of the band The Raconteurs. Brendan Benson was a composers & musicians from Royal Oak (b. 1970-11-14, Royal Oak).
